newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Tibet region inflation up 5.1 in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: China's Tibet region inflation up 5.1 in Jan-May.

text.p: Retail price inflation in China's remote southwestern region of Tibet grew by a year-on-year 5.1 percent in the January-May period, the official China Daily said on Saturday.
Consumer prices in Tibet rose by 6.5 percent in the first five months, the newspaper said.
Industrial production rose by 8.0 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said but gave no further details.
Tibet's retail price inflation fell to 7.2 percent in 1996 from 17.4 percent the year before, with consumer price inflation dropping to 7.8 percent from 19.4 percent, official figures show.
